module_signals.finding: Q2 FY27 8-K fully primary-sourced and folded in. But the release does NOT break out Gaming, Networking, segment detail, or a cash-flow statement, and the 10-Q is not yet read. The owner-earnings bridge that anchored the prior card cannot be closed from the 8-K alone -> M1 steps DOWN from +2 to +1 (haircut, not veto).

Mechanism intact and accelerating. Revenue $96.221B (+106% YoY, +18% QoQ); Data Center $89.0B (+117% YoY) = ~92% of revenue; Q3 guided to ~$108.0B. The AI-compute bottleneck thesis is delivering exactly as underwritten.

Full-stack capture unchanged; gross margin 75.0% held. Returned ~$26.0B in Q2 ($19.732B buyback + $6.047B dividends) with ~$99.0B authorization left. Operator grade carried at 4/5. Custom-silicon migration remains the one durability question that could matter.

THE CHANGED LEG, AND IT CHANGED DOWN. Prior card rested on a clean bridge: capex-light, FCF = owner earnings ~$182B. Q2 FY27 breaks it. GAAP net income $59,688M but operating cash flow only $24,077M (40%) and FCF $21,341M (36%) - inventory stands at $31,575M. Separately, GAAP EPS $2.46 EXCEEDS non-GAAP $2.22, which is backwards and is most plausibly non-cash mark-to-market gains on the $42,783M equity-securities book. Both point the same way: reported GAAP earnings currently overstate cash owner earnings. Neither can be resolved without the 10-Q. M4 drops +2 -> 0 on UNVERIFIED, not on proven deterioration.

No structural break. China Data Center compute is explicitly excluded from the Q3 outlook, so it stays recoverable optionality the guide does not count. Gross margin guided DOWN 75.0% -> 74.0% - small, but the first guided margin decline in the current run and worth logging. Pull-forward and custom-silicon remain size-control reasons, not vetoes.

Price $230.36 is +9.2% above the prior card. On the REPORTED owner-earnings base (Q2 non-GAAP net income annualized ~$215.5B; Q3 guide implies ~$241B), base 5y IRR = +7.25%, just under the 8% hurdle, and the 8%-neutral entry rises $181 -> ~$222. On the CASH-HAIRCUT base ($150B) the same model gives -1.1% IRR and a ~$148 entry. The honest buy-below is therefore a BAND of $148-222, and $230.36 sits above the top of it either way -> still no margin of safety.

capital_cycle.read: Unchanged from prior card. We do not know the turn timing. The applicable segment is raw compute, not the platform layer.
capital_cycle.caution: NONE material - one-way lens, not invoked to lift or lower this verdict

buy_below_note: Band, not a point. Top ($222.44) assumes the owner-earnings base is real at ~$225B. Bottom ($148.30) assumes owner earnings should be haircut toward demonstrated cash (~$150B). The 10-Q resolves which. Do NOT act on the top of the band before it does.
verdict_ceiling_source: PRICE first (above the band), then M4/M1 completeness (OE bridge unverified)
binding_constraint: TWO-PART, and the second part is new. (1) PRICE: $230.36 is above even the optimistic $222 entry. (2) OWNER-EARNINGS QUALITY: the FCF = OE bridge that justified the prior card broke this quarter and cannot be closed from the 8-K.
kill_criteria: K1 Revenue materially misses the ~$108B Q3 guide, or Data Center declines sequentially, or gross margin falls below 65%.
K2 Large-scale custom-silicon migration structurally erodes Data Center share (the only criterion that can escalate to a veto).
K3 Large inventory-commitment write-down (the $4.5B H20 charge is the precedent); inventory is now $31,575M and rising.
K4 Price persistently above the buy-below band without an evidenced upgrade to owner earnings -> stay WATCH. CURRENTLY TRIGGERED.
K5 NEW THIS REFRESH: the 10-Q shows the OCF/net-income gap is structural rather than a working-capital timing build -> re-underwrite M3/M4, do not simply widen the band.
watch_to_starter_trigger: Sequenced, not price-only. STEP 1: the Q2 FY27 10-Q closes the OE bridge (operating cash flow converges toward non-GAAP net income, and the GAAP-over-non-GAAP inversion is confirmed as investment gains rather than operating). STEP 2: only then does the ~$222 top-of-band become a live entry, and a pullback into it opens a 3-5% STARTER. Skipping step 1 means sizing on an earnings number the cash flow statement does not yet support.
runner_dissent: The mechanical output (WATCH) is the same as July, but I want it on record that the REASON inverted and that this is the most interesting name in the batch. In July the stock was expensive against a clean earnings base. Today it is roughly AT a fair price against an earnings base I cannot yet verify. Those are very different situations and the second one resolves on a single dated document. If the 10-Q closes the bridge, NVDA is the first STARTER candidate this book has had in this complex - and note the forward multiple COMPRESSED from ~28x to ~19x while the price rose 9.2%, because earnings outran the price. I am deliberately not pre-crediting that.
